definitions.api_key.description: "All requests on the elmah.io API needs to include an API key. The API key can be provided as part of the query string or as a request header. The name of the API key needs to be api_key.

Additional resources:
  • [Where is my API key?](https://docs.elmah.io/where-is-my-api-key/)
  • [How to configure API key permissions](https://docs.elmah.io/how-to-configure-api-key-permissions/)
"
